description: Is my x402 API losing rank in Bazaar search? The rank watch runs the rank check for your task now, then again every week for 30 days, and alerts you when your rank drops, you fall out of the results, or your share of voice across your category's buyer searches shrinks. One payment, no renewal. Status is free at the watch URL; an optional https webhook gets each drop. Price: $1.00 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Failed calls aren't charged.
